ideas.title: Investigating Government Transparency in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the lack of transparency in the Minnesota government, particularly in regards to the Trump administration's withholding of evidence in the shootings of Alex Pretti and Renee Good.
questions: What are the implications of the Trump administration's withholding of evidence?
How can government transparency be improved in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant issues with government accountability and transparency, and could lead to further investigation and reform.
